title: An Empirically-grounded tool for Automatic Prompt Linting and Repair: A Case Study on Bias, Vulnerability, and Optimization in Developer Prompts
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical identification and mitigation of demographic biases (gender, race, and sexuality) and security vulnerabilities in LLM prompts. It does not contain a specific component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, theology, or formal ethical frameworks.
